manifest.name: customer-bulk-run
manifest.description: One bulk application of a customer-data record action across many records. The idempotency key is business-derived from the action name and the canonical digest of the items - never from a clock or a random value - so retrying the same bulk returns this same run, and an interrupted run stays in_progress with its per-item receipts until it is resumed. A run whose items did not all apply reads partial, never completed.

migrations.name: create_customer_bulk_runs
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customer_bulk_runs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  idempotency_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  action_name TEXT CHECK(action_name IN ('link-canonical-identity', 'dismiss-duplicate-candidate', 'govern-data-quality-issue')),
  status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('in_progress', 'completed', 'partial')),
  item_count INTEGER,
  applied_count INTEGER,
  failed_count INTEGER,
  actor_type TEXT CHECK(actor_type IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  actor_id TEXT,
  started_at TEXT,
  finished_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS customer_bulk_runs_status ON customer_bulk_runs(status);

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_customer_bulk_runs
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."customer_bulk_runs" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "idempotency_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "action_name" TEXT CHECK("action_name" IN ('link-canonical-identity', 'dismiss-duplicate-candidate', 'govern-data-quality-issue')),
  "status" TEXT CHECK("status" IN ('in_progress', 'completed', 'partial')),
  "item_count" BIGINT,
  "applied_count" BIGINT,
  "failed_count" BIGINT,
  "actor_type" TEXT CHECK("actor_type" IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  "actor_id" TEXT,
  "started_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "finished_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "customer_bulk_runs_status"
  ON "accordo"."customer_bulk_runs"("status");
